title: SentinelMesh Trace row
description: One detection window from the gateway, used to train the FieldGuard on-device model. Derived from contracts/CONTRACT.md v1. Every feature is required: a missing field would silently become a zero in training, so the console drops rows that do not validate rather than poisoning the dataset.

label.description: set by the console's LABEL command; the ground truth for training

replay_rej.description: packets rejected by the sliding replay window

battery_pct.description: v4 energy delta: field node's battery level. Optional so pre-v4 producers keep validating.

frag_complete_pct.description: v4 energy delta: % of this sender's fragment sets that arrived complete. Optional, see battery_pct.

dup_pct.description: v4 energy delta: duplicate-packet rate on the link. Optional, see battery_pct.

$comment: additionalProperties is open so the console can stamp provenance (session, gw_label) without breaking firmware-side producers. sentinel_ml/field_model.py selects columns by name, so extra keys are ignored downstream. battery_pct/frag_complete_pct/dup_pct (v4) are deliberately NOT in `required`: they are EnergyGate's free signals, additive on top of the v1/v3 FieldGuard feature set, and existing producers should keep validating without them.
